subtitle: 배 놓친 도적의 기적의 외벽 탑승기

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. High-angle three-quarter view looking back from the stern of a departing wooden ship: on the left, the tiny Gnome Rogue with her daggers sheathed at her waist sprints desperately along a minimal wooden harbor pier edge with panicked wide eyes; on the right, the Dwarf Hunter with her blunderbuss slung on her back leans lazily on a minimal wooden ship railing beside a small wolf pet, watching calmly.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
놓친 김에 웃기려고
일단 뛰어보긴 하는데—!
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dynamic side-angle action shot: in the center, the Gnome Rogue with both daggers sheathed at her belt launches herself horizontally off a minimal wooden dock post in an exaggerated comedy dive, arms flailing wildly with Sprint speed lines and tiny blue water splash droplets trailing beneath her.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Low-angle close-up focused on a narrow wooden molding beam jutting out from a ship's outer hull on the right. The Gnome Rogue, daggers sheathed at her waist, has miraculously landed both boots squarely on the paper-thin ledge, wobbling slightly while peering down in stunned disbelief.

Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dramatic high-angle shot looking down along the vertical outer ship wall: at the top left, the Dwarf Hunter and her tiny wolf pet lean far over a minimal wooden deck railing with bulging shocked eyes and dropped jaws; far below on the right, the tiny Gnome Rogue stands completely stiff and deadpan, clinging with empty hands to the ridiculously thin wooden trim on the outside hull.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
대단하긴 한데, 대륙
넘어갈 때 로딩 뜨면 빠질걸?
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Over-the-shoulder medium view from behind the Dwarf Hunter on the left: with her gun slung on her back, she points casually toward the open white horizon with a dry, amused smirk while resting one arm on the minimal railing; below on the right, the Gnome Rogue sweats nervously on the narrow hull ledge.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
로딩도 버텼다!
다음 배 안 기다려도 되네!
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Low-angle triumphant view beside a minimal arrival wooden pier: on the right, still perched snugly on the ship's outer wooden hull ledge with daggers sheathed, the Gnome Rogue crosses her arms with a smug victorious grin; up on the left deck railing, the Dwarf Hunter stares down in speechless disbelief.
